remarks: Outstanding walk-to-town location! This spacious, renovated 2BR/2BA high-rise condo at One Strawberry Hill Avenue blends modern elegance with unbeatable convenience. An open-concept layout features brand-new floors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a screened-in balcony with stunning pool views. The updated kitchen boasts quartz/granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and soft-close cabinetry. Two large bedrooms offer expansive closets and en-suite baths, while an in-unit full-size washer/dryer adds ultimate convenience.  Top-tier building amenities include: 24-hour concierge, heated pool, two gyms, a library, and a beautifully redesigned lobby. Recent updates include a new facade, pool deck, and refreshed hallway carpets. One garage parking space included, with an option for a second at an additional cost.  Prime location-walk to downtown restaurants, shopping, library, theaters, and transit, with quick access to I-95 and the train station.   Available July 27  Excellent credit & proof of income required  No smoking of any kind  No dogs; up to two cats allowed ($250 non-refundable pet rent per pet)  Don't miss this opportunity-schedule your showing today!
